// Generator of lint-oracle.json: what the Go build of the freeze commit
// (238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8) answers for the lint Checks'
// functions on the inputs of lint-oracle-cases.json: the helper input of the
// combined ESLint run, the config hash, the generated tsconfig, tsc's output,
// the typed-lint config module, Biome's byte offsets, the readers of the
// linters' output and what lint.correctness, tests.smells, deps.engines,
// lint.typed and lint.existing make of runs. Kept as text, because the
// functions are unexported; regenerate from the repository root with:
//
//	cp internal/checks/testdata/lint-oracle.go.txt internal/checks/zz_lint_oracle_test.go
//	go test ./internal/checks -run TestZZLintOracle -count=1 && rm internal/checks/zz_lint_oracle_test.go
package checks

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/discovery"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/docker"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset"
)

type lintAnswer struct {
	Exit   int    `json:"exit"`
	Stdout string `json:"stdout"`
	Stderr string `json:"stderr"`
	OOM    bool   `json:"oom"`
	// Many generates an ESLint report of Count eqeqeq warnings and Gates no-undef errors.
	Many *struct {
		Count int `json:"count"`
		Gates int `json:"gates"`
	} `json:"many"`
}

type lintCases struct {
	HelperInputs []struct {
		Name    string            `json:"name"`
		Project string            `json:"project"`
		Files   map[string]string `json:"files"`
		Node    string            `json:"node"`
		Variant string            `json:"variant"`
		Groups  []string          `json:"groups"`
	} `json:"helperInputs"`
	ConfigHashes []string `json:"configHashes"`
	Tsconfigs    []struct {
		Files   []string `json:"files"`
		PkgPath string   `json:"pkgPath"`
		Node    string   `json:"node"`
		Mocha   bool     `json:"mocha"`
		Strict  bool     `json:"strict"`
	} `json:"tsconfigs"`
	TsTargets   []string `json:"tsTargets"`
	TscOutputs  []string `json:"tscOutputs"`
	TypedConfig []struct {
		Files map[string]string `json:"files"`
	} `json:"typedConfigs"`
	BiomeLines []struct {
		Src    string `json:"src"`
		Offset int    `json:"offset"`
	} `json:"biomeLines"`
	Parsing []struct {
		Name   string            `json:"name"`
		Kind   string            `json:"kind"`
		Files  map[string]string `json:"files"`
		Pkg    string            `json:"pkg"`
		Stdout string            `json:"stdout"`
	} `json:"parsing"`
	Hits []struct {
		Name      string            `json:"name"`
		Check     string            `json:"check"`
		Project   string            `json:"project"`
		Files     map[string]string `json:"files"`
		Pkg       string            `json:"pkg"`
		Output    string            `json:"output"`
		Oversized []string          `json:"oversized"`
		// Many adds a file with Count hits of Rule to the output.
		Many *struct {
			Path  string `json:"path"`
			Rule  string `json:"rule"`
			Count int    `json:"count"`
		} `json:"many"`
	} `json:"hits"`
	Typed []struct {
		Name      string            `json:"name"`
		Files     map[string]string `json:"files"`
		ESLint    string            `json:"eslint"`
		Oversized []string          `json:"oversized"`
		Failed    string            `json:"failed"`
		Exit      int               `json:"exit"`
		TSC       string            `json:"tsc"`
		TSCExit   int               `json:"tscExit"`
	} `json:"typed"`
	EngineVersions []struct {
		Version string `json:"version"`
		Variant string `json:"variant"`
	} `json:"engineVersions"`
	Existing []struct {
		Name        string                `json:"name"`
		Files       map[string]string     `json:"files"`
		Answers     map[string]lintAnswer `json:"answers"`
		Unsupported *struct {
			Code   string `json:"code"`
			Reason string `json:"reason"`
		} `json:"unsupported"`
	} `json:"existing"`
}

func zzFindings(fs []resultset.Finding) any {
	if len(fs) > 20 {
		return map[string]any{"count": len(fs), "first": zzFindings(fs[:2]), "last": zzFindings(fs[len(fs)-2:])}
	}
	out := []map[string]any{}
	for _, f := range fs {
		m := map[string]any{
			"rule": *f.RuleID, "title": f.Title, "message": f.Message, "gate": f.Gate, "severity": f.Severity,
			"confidence": f.Confidence, "kind": f.Kind, "in_test_code": f.InTestCode,
			"fingerprint": f.Fingerprint.Value, "limitations": f.Limitations,
		}
		if len(f.Locations) > 0 {
			l := f.Locations[0]
			m["path"], m["sha"] = l.Path, l.FileSHA256
			if l.Start != nil {
				m["line"] = l.Start.Line
				if l.Start.Column != nil {
					m["column"] = *l.Start.Column
				}
			}
		}
		if len(f.Evidence) > 0 {
			m["evidence"], m["origin"], m["trust"] = f.Evidence[0].Text, f.Evidence[0].Origin, f.Evidence[0].Trust
		}
		out = append(out, m)
	}
	return out
}

func zzResult(res *Result) map[string]any {
	m := map[string]any{
		"status": res.Status, "reasonCode": res.ReasonCode, "reason": res.Reason, "command": res.Command,
		"findings": zzFindings(res.Findings),
	}
	if res.Tool != nil {
		t := map[string]any{"name": res.Tool.Name}
		if res.Tool.Version != nil {
			t["version"] = *res.Tool.Version
		}
		if res.Tool.ExitCode != nil {
			t["exit"] = *res.Tool.ExitCode
		}
		m["tool"] = t
	}
	var lims []map[string]any
	for _, l := range res.Limitations {
		c := ""
		if l.CheckID != nil {
			c = *l.CheckID
		}
		lims = append(lims, map[string]any{"code": l.ReasonCode, "message": l.Message, "check": c})
	}
	m["limitations"] = lims
	var arts []map[string]any
	for _, a := range res.Artifacts {
		arts = append(arts, map[string]any{"id": a.ID, "path": a.Path, "mediaType": a.MediaType, "content": string(a.Content)})
	}
	m["artifacts"] = arts
	var tools []map[string]any
	for _, c := range res.ContextTools {
		d := ""
		if c.Digest != nil {
			d = *c.Digest
		}
		tools = append(tools, map[string]any{"name": c.Name, "version": c.Version, "digest": d})
	}
	m["contextTools"] = tools
	var metrics []map[string]any
	for _, x := range res.Metrics {
		metrics = append(metrics, map[string]any{"name": x.Name, "unit": x.Unit, "value": *x.Value})
	}
	m["metrics"] = metrics
	return m
}

func zzInput(t *testing.T, project string, files map[string]string, pkg string) *Input {
	t.Helper()
	if pkg == "" {
		pkg = "."
	}
	var proj *discovery.Project
	var dir string
	if project != "" {
		proj, dir = eslintProblems(t)
	} else {
		proj, dir = writeTree(t, files)
	}
	return &Input{Project: proj, Context: packageContext(t, proj, pkg), OriginalPath: "/original", SnapshotDir: dir}
}

func TestZZLintOracle(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/lint-oracle-cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases lintCases
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := map[string]any{}

	var helperInputs []string
	for _, c := range cases.HelperInputs {
		in := zzInput(t, c.Project, c.Files, ".")
		if c.Node != "" {
			in.Context.Node.Version = c.Node
		}
		if c.Variant != "" {
			in.Context.Node.Variant = c.Variant
		}
		var groups []eslintGroup
		for _, id := range c.Groups {
			groups = append(groups, eslintGroups[id])
		}
		input, err := eslintHelperInput(in, groups)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		data, _ := json.Marshal(input)
		helperInputs = append(helperInputs, string(data))
	}
	out["helperInputs"] = helperInputs

	var hashes []string
	for _, c := range cases.ConfigHashes {
		var v map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c), &v); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		hashes = append(hashes, configHash(v))
	}
	out["configHashes"] = hashes

	var tsconfigs []string
	for _, c := range cases.Tsconfigs {
		data, err := typesTsconfigFor(c.Files, c.PkgPath, c.Node, c.Mocha, c.Strict)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		tsconfigs = append(tsconfigs, string(data))
	}
	out["tsconfigs"] = tsconfigs

	var targets []string
	for _, c := range cases.TsTargets {
		targets = append(targets, tsTarget(c))
	}
	out["tsTargets"] = targets

	var tsc []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.TscOutputs {
		diags, global := parseTSC(c)
		var ds []map[string]any
		for _, d := range diags {
			ds = append(ds, map[string]any{"path": d.Path, "line": d.Line, "column": d.Column, "category": d.Category, "code": d.Code, "message": d.Message})
		}
		tsc = append(tsc, map[string]any{"diagnostics": ds, "global": global})
	}
	out["tscOutputs"] = tsc

	var typedConfigs []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.TypedConfig {
		in := zzInput(t, "", c.Files, ".")
		list, _ := typedLintRuleList(in)
		typedConfigs = append(typedConfigs, map[string]any{
			"module": typedLintConfigModule(in), "hash": typedLintRulesHash(), "ruleList": string(list),
			"command": typedLintCommand([]string{"src/a.js", "-x.js"}),
		})
	}
	out["typedConfigs"] = typedConfigs

	var lines [][]int
	for _, c := range cases.BiomeLines {
		l, col := biomeLineAndColumn(c.Src, c.Offset)
		lines = append(lines, []int{l, col})
	}
	out["biomeLines"] = lines

	var parsing []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Parsing {
		in := zzInput(t, "", c.Files, c.Pkg)
		var fs []resultset.Finding
		var err error
		if c.Kind == "biome" {
			fs, err = biomeFindings(in, []byte(c.Stdout))
		} else {
			fs, err = projectESLintFindings(in, []byte(c.Stdout))
		}
		m := map[string]any{"findings": zzFindings(fs), "error": err != nil}
		if err != nil {
			m["errorText"] = err.Error()
		}
		evidence := []string{}
		for _, f := range fs {
			evidence = append(evidence, f.Evidence[0].Text)
		}
		m["evidence"] = evidence
		parsing = append(parsing, m)
	}
	out["parsing"] = parsing

	var hits []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Hits {
		in := zzInput(t, c.Project, c.Files, c.Pkg)
		var o eslintOutput
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(c.Output), &o); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if c.Many != nil {
			var msgs []eslintMessage
			for i := 1; i <= c.Many.Count; i++ {
				msgs = append(msgs, eslintMessage{RuleID: c.Many.Rule, Message: fmt.Sprintf("hit %d", i), Line: i, Column: 1})
			}
			o.Results = append(o.Results, eslintFileResult{Path: c.Many.Path, Messages: msgs})
		}
		command := o.Command
		if len(command) == 0 {
			command = []string{"node", "/jspf/eslint-run.js", "/jspf/input.json"}
		}
		run := &eslintRun{Output: o, ConfigSHA256: configHash(o.Config), ExitCode: o.ExitCode, Command: command, Oversized: c.Oversized}
		var res *Result
		switch c.Check {
		case "lint.correctness":
			res = interpretLintCorrectness(in, run)
		case "tests.smells":
			res = interpretTestsSmells(in, run)
		case "deps.engines":
			res = interpretDepsEngines(in, run)
		}
		m := zzResult(res)
		m["configSHA256"] = run.ConfigSHA256
		hits = append(hits, m)
	}
	out["hits"] = hits

	var typed []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Typed {
		in := zzInput(t, "", c.Files, ".")
		msgs, err := parseTypedLintOutput([]byte(c.ESLint), "/work")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		run := typedLintRun{Messages: msgs, ExitCode: c.Exit, Oversized: c.Oversized, Failed: c.Failed}
		if c.TSC != "" {
			diags, global := parseTSC(c.TSC)
			run.TSC = &tscRun{Diagnostics: diags, Global: global, Exit: c.TSCExit}
		}
		typed = append(typed, zzResult(interpretTypedLint(in, run)))
	}
	out["typed"] = typed

	var versions []string
	for _, c := range cases.EngineVersions {
		in := zzInput(t, "eslint-problems", nil, ".")
		in.Context.Node.Version = c.Version
		if c.Variant != "" {
			in.Context.Node.Variant = c.Variant
		}
		versions = append(versions, engineNodeVersion(in.Context))
	}
	out["engineVersions"] = versions

	var existing []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Existing {
		in := zzInput(t, "", c.Files, ".")
		if c.Unsupported != nil {
			in.Context.Package.InstallUnsupported = &discovery.Unsupported{Code: c.Unsupported.Code, Reason: c.Unsupported.Reason}
		}
		var commands [][]string
		old := runLintContainer
		runLintContainer = func(_ context.Context, _ *Input, _ string, cmd []string) (*docker.ContainerResult, error) {
			commands = append(commands, cmd)
			key := ""
			joined := strings.Join(cmd, " ")
			switch {
			case len(cmd) > 1 && cmd[1] == "-p" && strings.Contains(cmd[2], "eslint"):
				key = "version:eslint"
			case len(cmd) > 1 && cmd[1] == "-p":
				key = "version:biome"
			case strings.Contains(joined, "--vcs-enabled=false"):
				key = "biome-novcs"
			case strings.Contains(joined, "eslint.js"):
				key = "eslint"
			default:
				key = "biome"
			}
			a, ok := c.Answers[key]
			if ok && a.Many != nil {
				msgs := ""
				for i := 0; i < a.Many.Count; i++ {
					msgs += `{"ruleId":"eqeqeq","severity":1,"message":"w","line":1,"column":1},`
				}
				for i := 0; i < a.Many.Gates; i++ {
					msgs += `{"ruleId":"no-undef","severity":2,"message":"e","line":1,"column":1},`
				}
				a.Stdout = `[{"filePath":"/work/a.js","messages":[` + strings.TrimSuffix(msgs, ",") + `]}]`
			}
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s: no answer for %s", c.Name, joined)
			}
			return &docker.ContainerResult{ExitCode: a.Exit, Stdout: []byte(a.Stdout), Stderr: []byte(a.Stderr), OOMKilled: a.OOM}, nil
		}
		res := lintExisting{}.Run(context.Background(), in)
		runLintContainer = old
		m := zzResult(res)
		m["commands"] = commands
		existing = append(existing, m)
	}
	out["existing"] = existing

	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/lint-oracle.json", append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
